```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)

#Load in data
Solar_ATB <- read.csv("Processed_Data/Solar_ATB_Processed.csv")
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Model2.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Class + Technology +
                Net_Cap_Factor,
             data = Solar_ATB)
summary(Model2.lm)
plot(Model2.lm)
```

```{r}
# Remove data point 28,29,30
Solar_ATB_Model2.2 <- Solar_ATB[-c(28,29,30),]
Model2.2.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Class + Technology +
                Net_Cap_Factor,
             data = Solar_ATB_Model2.2)
summary(Model2.2.lm)
plot(Model2.2.lm)
```
